map.📚 深度解析：粉体材料三项检测判定（粒度/浓度/PH）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Powder Materials (Particle Size / Concentration / pH)
map.粉体进场自检：按平均粒度、悬浮液浓度、PH 三项判定: Powder incoming self-check: judge by three items — mean particle size, slurry concentration, pH
map.工艺适配：粒度分布关系分散与烧结: Process fit: particle-size distribution relates to dispersion and sintering
map.逐项判定：平均粒度 1~100μm、浓度 10~30%、PH 6~8；三项均满足: Item-by-item: mean particle size 1~100 μm, concentration 10~30%, pH 6~8; all three satisfied = pass. Particle size determines dispersibility and final performance; concentration/pH relate to slurry stability.
map.粒度 50μm（区间✓）、浓度 20%（区间✓）、PH 7（区间✓）：三项全合格: Particle size 50 μm (range ✓), concentration 20% (range ✓), pH 7 (range ✓): all three pass → qualified. If particle size rises to 120 μm it fails, exceeding the process upper limit.
map.粒度区间为什么这么宽？: Why is the particle-size range so wide?
map.不同粉体用途粒度差异大（纳米到百微米），1~100μm 为示例区间；实际须按产品: Powders for different uses vary widely in particle size (nano to hundreds of μm); 1~100 μm is an example range — actual upper/lower limits depend on product specs.
map.PH 偏酸偏碱会怎样？: What if pH is too acid or too alkaline?
map.偏离 6~8 可能使浆料絮凝或分散过度、影响涂布/烧结；须用pH调节剂控制在工艺: Deviation from 6~8 may cause flocculation or over-dispersion of the slurry, affecting coating/sintering; use a pH adjuster to keep it within the process window.
map.粒度分析需使用激光粒度仪或筛分法: Particle-size analysis requires a laser diffractor or sieving method
map.悬浮液浓度测试需充分搅匀后取样: Slurry concentration testing requires thorough mixing before sampling

Suitable for particle-size and concentration testing of powder coatings, abrasives, and ceramic slurries.
